decisions.reason: The same source message already has a complete candidate MODIFY recording support for all 77 Google Play languages; no additional update or removal is required.
Selecting all approximately 40 App Store languages changes localization coverage but does not necessarily alter the current iOS download-size optimization strategies.
The language-set decision does not change the Android package-size optimization goal or its existing asset-packaging strategies.
The number of supported store languages does not change the established tutorial delivery mechanism or reusable translatable-text presentation format.
